title: Rat King: do range-conditional gun bonuses (Long Range, Sharpshooter, Close Quarters, Point Blank) add to Scrap Grenade damage?
question: Game files scale Scrap Grenade only with EBaseWeaponDamageIncrease (70 + 0.6x per detonation). Long Range/Sharpshooter (LONG_RANGE_BULLET_DAMAGE_INCREASE) and Close Quarters/Point Blank (CLOSE_RANGE_WEAPON_DAMAGE_INCREASE) are separate conditional bonuses. Do they still raise the damage a detonation deals to a hero?
hypothesis: No: per-detonation damage with each range item equals the no-item baseline (within 5%) at its range. Prediction if they DID apply: Long Range +40%, Sharpshooter +60% (+6 flat) at 20m; Close Quarters +20%, Point Blank +50% at 8m.

arms.name: C_sharpshooter_20m
arms.notes: throw from 20m; expect +6 flat from its 10% Weapon Damage only

setup.level_or_boons: same level every arm, grenade T1, no investment bonus differences (give items with no other weapon items)
setup.position: flat ground, target at measured 20m or 8m

controls: Same distance per pair (A/B/C at 20m, D/E/F at 8m)
Grenade lands at the target's feet every trial
No other weapon damage items; weapon investment tier equal across arms (Sharpshooter costs more: compare against its own +10% Weapon Damage expectation)
procedure: Throw one grenade at the target
Read the damage number of the first detonation
Reset, repeat; interleave arms A,B,C then D,E,F

decision.rule: SUPPORTS range bonus applying if an item arm beats its baseline by >=10% with non-overlapping trial ranges (beyond Sharpshooter's own +6); REFUTES if within 5%; else INCONCLUSIVE. If Close Quarters/Point Blank SUPPORT, put Close Quarters → Point Blank into ratking_grenade in place of Extended Magazine → Titanic Magazine; if Long Range/Sharpshooter SUPPORT, revisit them for the thrower.
